headline: Hitech Corporation Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Hitech Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Corrigendum to Outcome of Reverse Book Building Process ("RBBP") issued in accordance Regulation 17(3) and other applicable provisions with Securities…
detail: General Updates - Hitech Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Corrigendum to Outcome of Reverse Book Building Process ("RBBP") issued in accordance Regulation 17(3) and other applicable provisions with Securities and Exchange Board of India (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021, as amended ( SEBI Delisting Regulations ) and to post offer public announcement ( Post Offer PA ) issued in accordance Regulation 17(4) and other applicable provisions of  SEBI Delisting Regulations for the delisting of the equity shares of Hitech Corporation Limited ("the Company )
